372:t_010:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'll make it work! For the sake of everyone who believes in us!」

372:t_010:8.en:
$$一太郎$$
「Using $$トライダーＧ７$$ as a reference, I made a program that improves the energy transmission circuit! I'm sending it to you now!」

372:t_010:10.en:
$$源五郎$$
「Don't you lose, $$勝平$$, $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$!」

372:t_010:12.en:
$$源五郎$$
「I heard from Grandpa that you're in Japan. $$大太$$, $$久作$$ and I are all hanging in there, too.」

372:t_011:0.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「$$勝平$$! The program is done installing! Go all out!」

372:t_012:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「Amazing! The power efficiency is on a whole different level from before!」

372:t_012:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's Big Bro Ichi for you! Time for the finisher!」

372:t_013:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Whoa! The Moon Attack got more powerful, too!」

372:t_013:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「The moon lights up the dark night... You've gotten strong, $$勝平$$.」

372:t_013:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh... With that many people counting on me, I'd get this way whether I liked it or not.」

372:t_014:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「And... I'm sorry. For calling you a hopeless president.」

372:t_014:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm the one who's sorry! Let's fight together, $$勝平$$!」

372:t_014:4.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Don't let your guard down, $$勝平$$. There's still that army of mystery robots, you know.」

372:t_014:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「I know! But I won't let them lay a single finger on anyone in town!」

372:t_014:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Watch me, $$香月$$, $$アキ$$, $$ミチ$$! I'm never going to lose!!」

372:t_015:1.en:
$$葵$$
「By the way, what happened to $$ギルター$$?」

372:t_015:2.en:
$$くらら$$
「$$エコーズ$$ went after him, but I heard he got away.」

372:t_015:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Still the only thing that guy's fast at is running away.」

372:t_016:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh... $$香月$$, $$アキ$$, $$ミチ$$, you all look like you're doing fine.」

372:t_016:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$勝平$$. You're the one who protected their smiles.」

372:t_016:5.en:
$$勝平$$
(Dad... What we've been doing wasn't pointless, was it...)

372:t_016:6.en:
$$勝平$$
(So I'll fight. Even if it's hard, even if I'm scared...)

372:t_017:0.en:
$n
(I don't have Miss $$スズネ$$ to help me... I have to sharpen my own senses...!)

372:t_017:1.en:
$n
(Use no way as way, have no limitation as limitation...! I haven't gone past my limit yet!)

372:t_018:0.en:
$$木下$$
「Twenty-five units down in this one minute! We really went out with a bang!」

372:t_018:1.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Magnificent...! That is truly the momentum of splitting bamboo!」

372:t_018:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You mean they've got momentum like cows and pigs?」

372:t_018:3.en:
$$郁絵$$
「President... That is not the momentum of livestock.」

372:t_018:4.en:
$$厚井$$
「Looks like he needs special training in his schoolwork, too...」

372:t_100:0.en:
$n
(Come to think of it, at first I was riding $$ジェニオン$$ all by myself...)

372:t_100:1.en:
$n
(To get Miss $$スズネ$$ back, I'm going to get stronger... And for that, I'll go back to the basics once more...!)

372:t_101:0.en:
$$勝平$$
(The 《$$コンピュータードール#keyword$$》 of $$ガイゾック$$ said the people of Earth aren't worth protecting...)

372:t_101:1.en:
$$勝平$$
(Like I'd listen to anything a guy like that says! I'll protect them, no matter what...! Our planet and the people who live on it!)

372:t_102:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(You've gotten strong, $$勝平$$. I can't afford to lose, either...!)

372:t_102:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(The sun is with me! If $$勝平$$ is going to be the moon that lights the dark night, then I'll be the sun!)

372:t_103:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Looking at that $$香月$$ kid reminds me of $$トウジ$$...)

372:t_103:1.en:
$$シンジ$$
($$トウジ$$ and $$ケンスケ$$ aren't here anymore... But I'll fight...)

372:t_103:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I want to fight to protect someone, too, just like $$勝平$$.)
